conclusion: 研究结果表明，显式推理目标相关性与视图间冗余是高效场景重建的根本性因素，所提选择器以低得多的选择成本实现了跨范式、跨采集的通用视角选择，并证明「少而精」的输入子集可优于全量输入。

title: LEGAU: Learning Semantic Gaussian Priors for Scalable Category-level Pose Estimation
abstract: Category-level 6D pose estimation from a single RGB-D observation is inherently under-constrained, since partial visible geometry must be interpreted together with a canonical object structure before a stable pose can be determined. We present LEGAU, a unified framework that jointly predicts NOCS correspondence, object pose and size, and a canonical Semantic Gaussian Field. Rather than treating reconstruction as a detached auxiliary task, LEGAU uses the Gaussian field as a category-conditioned structural prior that participates in multimodal feature fusion and provides global guidance for local pose reasoning. Conditioned on a categorical text embedding, LEGAU processes RGB-D observations through a transformer-based fusion module that integrates visual, geometric, and category-level cues, decoding the NOCS map, pose and size information and the Gaussian-based object representation. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that this coupled pose-shape formulation achieves strong performance in a single-model multi-category setting, with up to 22\% on SOPE and competitive transfer to real-world data. These results highlight the benefit of jointly learning canonical correspondence, object shape, and pose alignment within a unified representation.
tldr: LEGAU通过联合学习语义高斯先验、NOCS对应与位姿尺寸，实现可扩展的类别级6D位姿估计。
motivation: 单张RGB-D的类别级6D位姿估计本质欠约束，局部可见几何必须与规范物体结构联合解释才能确定稳定位姿。现有方法常将重建视为独立辅助任务，未充分利用类别级结构先验来指导位姿推理。
method: LEGAU提出统一框架，联合预测NOCS对应、物体位姿与尺寸以及规范语义高斯场；该高斯场作为类别条件结构先验参与多模态特征融合，并为局部位姿推理提供全局引导。模型以类别文本嵌入为条件，通过Transformer融合RGB-D的视觉、几何与类别线索，解码NOCS图、位姿尺寸及高斯物体表示。
result: 在合成与真实世界基准上，该联合位姿-形状框架在单模型多类别设置中表现强劲，SOPE指标最高提升22%，并展现出具有竞争力的真实数据迁移能力。
conclusion: 结果表明，在统一表示中联合学习规范对应、物体形状与位姿对齐能带来显著收益，为可扩展的类别级6D位姿估计提供了有效思路。

title: EviSplat: Preserving Multi-View Evidence in 3D Gaussian Splatting for Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding enables object localization and segmentation from free-form text queries without a fixed category vocabulary. Many recent methods build on 3D Gaussian Splatting and consolidate multi-view observations, such as masked crops from individual views, into language features or compact object descriptors before the query is known. However, observations of the same object vary across viewpoints and are not equally informative: some reveal cues relevant to a particular query, whereas others provide incomplete or misleading evidence. Pre-query consolidation can therefore suppress cues on which a later query depends. We introduce EviSplat, which preserves individual observation features as evidence for later text queries. EviSplat retains individual observation features within class-agnostic 3D instances that represent objects, object parts, or background regions. It also learns, for each Gaussian, a distribution describing which visual appearances its observations support. Given a text query, EviSplat scores each instance using its most relevant observations. It then computes a score for each Gaussian by combining instance-level relevance with locally supported evidence, weighted by how often and how unambiguously that Gaussian was observed. Different queries can thus draw on different visual cues from the same preserved evidence. Experiments across diverse datasets and evaluation protocols demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, supporting the benefit of preserving multi-view evidence until query time and aggregating it according to the query.
tldr: EviSplat将多视角观测保留为3D实例证据，查询时按相关性聚合，提升开放词汇分割。
motivation: 现有开放词汇3D理解方法常基于3D Gaussian Splatting，在文本查询前将多视角掩码裁剪等观测压缩为语言特征或物体描述符。然而同一物体的不同视角信息量不同，部分观测对后续查询关键，预查询压缩会抑制这些线索。
method: EviSplat将每个观测特征作为证据保留在类无关3D实例（物体、部件或背景区域）中，并为每个高斯学习其观测所支持的视觉外观分布。给定文本查询时，它先以实例最相关的观测计算实例分数，再结合实例级相关性与局部支持证据，并按高斯被观测的频率和明确程度加权得到高斯分数，使不同查询可调用同一证据中的不同视觉线索。
result: 在多种数据集和评估协议上达到当前最优，表明将多视角证据保留至查询时并按查询聚合具有优势；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: EviSplat的贡献在于避免查询前证据压缩，保留多视角观测并支持查询时动态聚合，从而提升开放词汇3D分割能力。该思路有望推动依赖自由文本查询的3D场景理解及相关应用。

title: GenNVS: Geometry-enhanced Novel View Synthesis via Disentangled 3D Prior
abstract: Single-image novel view synthesis remains challenging because the underlying 3D geometry is highly ambiguous. Recent diffusion-based approaches produce plausible results, but they often struggle to preserve the geometric structure and spatial coherence of foreground objects. We present GenNVS, a framework for geometry-enhanced novel view synthesis via a disentangled 3D prior. Specifically, GenNVS models foreground objects and the background with 3D Gaussian Splatting and aligns them through a coarse-to-fine geometric optimization process to form a unified 3D scene. This scene conditions a video diffusion model through the proposed Dual-Stream Masking mechanism, which guides synthesis by jointly exploiting rendered validity masks and geometry-aware warping. Experimental results show that GenNVS performs favorably against recent methods in both visual quality and geometric accuracy, while naturally supporting flexible scene editing.
tldr: GenNVS通过解耦3D先验与双流掩码条件视频扩散，提升单图新视角合成的几何保真度。
motivation: 单图像新视角合成因底层3D几何高度歧义而困难，现有扩散方法虽能生成合理结果，却难以保持前景物体的几何结构与空间一致性。为此，作者提出GenNVS以增强几何一致性。
method: GenNVS使用3D高斯泼溅分别建模前景物体与背景，并通过从粗到细的几何优化将它们对齐为统一3D场景。该场景经双流掩码机制，联合渲染有效性掩码与几何感知变形来条件化视频扩散模型，从而引导新视角合成。
result: 实验表明，GenNVS在视觉质量和几何精度上均优于近期方法，并能自然支持灵活的场景编辑；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: GenNVS通过解耦3D先验、统一3D场景表示与双流掩码条件视频扩散，提升了单图新视角合成的几何保真度与编辑灵活性。该工作为几何增强的新视角合成提供了有效思路。

title: RRG-SLAM: Real-time Reflection-aware Gaussian SLAM for Indoor Scenes
abstract: We introduce the first real-time reflection-aware Gaussian SLAM system for indoor scenes. The system features a reflection-aware TSDF-Gaussian hybrid representation that explicitly separates diffuse scene appearance from reflection components. The base scene is modeled by a TSDF volume and a set of base Gaussians capturing geometry and diffuse appearance, while planar reflections are represented by reflection Gaussian groups associated with detected reflective planes. The rendering is performed in three passes: TSDF raycasting first yields surface color, depth, plane IDs and reflection masks; base Gaussians are then rendered order-independently with depth culling and combined with the TSDF output to form the base image; finally, under the guidance of the plane ID map, reflection Gaussians from different reflection groups are rasterized only into their corresponding planar regions to generate the reflection image, which is subsequently composited with the base image via the reflection mask to produce the final output. For online reconstruction, our system first estimates the camera pose through reflection-aware tracking to suppress interference of reflection-dominated regions. It then identifies reflective planes using geometric, semantic, and temporal cues, and fuses the observations into the augmented TSDF volume with reflection-aware attributes. Afterwards the base and reflection Gaussians are initialized, optimized, and pruned online to maintain both reconstruction quality and efficiency. Experiments on a variety of datasets show that our method outperforms existing SLAM systems in reconstruction quality, tracking robustness, and novel-view rendering for indoor environments with reflections, while preserving real-time performance.
tldr: 提出首个面向室内场景的实时反射感知高斯SLAM，分离漫反射与平面反射以提升重建、跟踪和新视角渲染。
motivation: 室内场景中的镜面与平面反射会干扰视觉SLAM的几何重建和相机跟踪，现有系统通常未显式建模反射，导致反射主导区域跟踪不稳与渲染失真。该工作旨在实现实时、反射感知的室内SLAM。
method: 提出反射感知的TSDF-Gaussian混合表示，用TSDF体素和基础高斯建模基础场景，用与检测反射平面关联的反射高斯组建模平面反射。渲染分三遍：TSDF射线投射输出颜色、深度、平面ID和反射掩码，基础高斯经深度剔除后与TSDF合成基础图像，反射高斯按平面ID仅栅格化到对应平面区域并经反射掩码合成。在线运行时先进行反射感知跟踪以抑制反射干扰，再利用几何、语义和时序线索识别反射平面并融合到带反射属性的TSDF，最后在线初始化、优化和剪枝基础与反射高斯。
result: 在多种数据集上的实验表明，该方法在含反射室内环境中的重建质量、跟踪鲁棒性和新视角渲染方面优于现有SLAM系统，同时保持实时性能；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作提出首个实时反射感知高斯SLAM系统，通过显式分离漫反射与平面反射实现鲁棒跟踪和高质量重建/渲染，为含反射室内场景的SLAM提供了新方案。

title: Rate-Distortion Adaptive Primitive Selection for Omnidirectional Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Learned image codecs (LICs) achieve high reconstruction quality, but their decoding speed is often insufficient for immersive virtual reality (VR). Gaussian splatting (GS) codecs render much faster, yet still lag in reconstruction quality and typically decide primitive allocation without considering the coding cost of each primitive. We introduce OIC-GS, an omnidirectional GS codec with a new hierarchical HEALPix primitive grid representation. Gaussian primitives are anchored at predefined spherical locations, eliminating explicit coordinate coding. Finer levels refine their coarser ancestors, naturally supporting coarse-to-fine reconstruction and layered transmission. The predefined grid also enables efficient viewport decoding by selecting only view-relevant primitives. We further introduce a lightweight entropy model for quantized primitives and optimize the codec under a spherical rate-distortion objective. Primitives with insufficient rate-distortion benefit are automatically removed when their quantized opacity becomes zero, allowing OIC-GS to adapt both primitive density and level of detail without a fixed primitive budget. A single bitstream supports full-sphere, viewport-dependent, and progressive decoding. The first viewport reaches final quality after decoding only 52% of the bitstream, and is then rendered at 1,270 FPS. On a 100-image omnidirectional benchmark, OIC-GS outperforms all evaluated GS codecs, reducing WS-PSNR BD-rate by 49.6% over GaussianImage++ and 68.6% over SGI, which uses a learned entropy model.
tldr: 提出OIC-GS全向高斯泼溅编解码器，用HEALPix分层基元网格与率失真自适应选择，实现快速视口解码和高压缩效率。
motivation: 面向沉浸式VR，现有LIC解码速度不足，而GS编解码虽渲染快但重建质量较低且未考虑基元编码代价来分配基元。本文旨在提升全向GS编解码的率失真性能与视口解码效率。
method: 提出OIC-GS，采用分层HEALPix基元网格，将高斯基元锚定在预定义球面位置以省去坐标编码；细层细化粗层，支持由粗到细重建与分层传输。引入轻量熵模型对量化基元建模，在球面率失真目标下优化；量化不透明度为零且率失真收益不足的基元被自动移除，自适应基元密度与LOD，单一码流支持全球、视口相关和渐进解码。
result: 首个视口只需解码52%码流即达最终质量，渲染速度达1,270 FPS；在100图像全向基准上优于所有对比GS编解码器，WS-PSNR BD-rate较GaussianImage++降低49.6%，较SGI降低68.6%。
conclusion: OIC-GS通过率失真自适应基元选择与分层网格，在全向GS压缩、视口自适应和渐进传输上取得显著提升，为沉浸式VR高质量快速渲染提供高效码流方案。

title: AGILE-GS: Anchor-Guided Fast Next-Best-View Selection for Active 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Radiance fields need hundreds of views, and their placement matters as much as their number. Next-best-view (NBV) selection for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) usually scores every candidate in the pool and keeps one. Searching for information and choosing a camera, however, are separable problems. We present AGILE-GS, an anchor-guided NBV method that separates the two. A virtual anchor pose is optimized on SE(3) by Riemannian gradient ascent on expected information gain. It need not be reachable or in the pool; it marks where the model is most uncertain. Candidates are scored against the anchor's viewing geometry, and a greedy ridge-leverage step distills the pool into a small, non-redundant shortlist without rendering any candidate. The shortlist can be used in two ways. AGILE-GS takes the first view on it as the next view, so no Fisher information is computed for any candidate. AGILE-GS+ computes the Fisher information gain of each shortlisted view and picks the best, so the expensive evaluation runs on a handful of views rather than the whole pool. On standard benchmarks and in closed-loop embodied acquisition, both match or exceed existing baselines while cutting selection latency by one to two orders of magnitude.
tldr: AGILE-GS通过虚拟锚点分离信息搜索与相机选择，在保持重建质量的同时将NBV选择延迟降低1–2个数量级。
motivation: 辐射场重建通常需要数百个视角，且视角位置与数量同样关键。现有3DGS的NBV选择往往对候选池中每个视角逐一评分再选一个，导致选择过程昂贵且存在冗余。本文将信息搜索与相机选择解耦，以缓解候选评估的计算瓶颈。
method: AGILE-GS在SE(3)上通过期望信息增益的黎曼梯度上升优化一个虚拟锚点位姿，该锚点无需可达或属于候选池，用于标识模型最不确定的区域。候选视角仅依据锚点观测几何评分，并通过贪心ridge-leverage步骤在不渲染任何候选的情况下将候选池压缩为小而互不冗余的候选短列表。AGILE-GS直接选取短列表首个视角，不计算Fisher信息；AGILE-GS+仅对短列表内视角计算Fisher信息增益并选最优，从而把昂贵评估限制在少量视角上。
result: 在标准基准和闭环具身采集任务中，AGILE-GS与AGILE-GS+均达到或超过现有基线，同时将NBV选择延迟降低1–2个数量级。
conclusion: 该方法证明NBV中的信息搜索与相机选择可有效解耦，通过锚点引导和ridge-leverage短列表显著加速主动3DGS采集。其贡献包括可优化虚拟锚点、无需渲染的候选蒸馏以及两种延迟—质量权衡方案，有望推动高效主动重建与具身探索。

title: Functional Hand Type Prior for 3D Hand Pose Estimation and Action Recognition from Egocentric View Monocular Videos
abstract: Current methods for egocentric view action recognition often face challenges in perceiving dynamic hand movements relying solely on geometrical or physical information. In this work, we effectively address this problem by gaining insights into the correlation between functional hand configurations and objects, which improves the detailed interpretation of real-world scenarios. To this end, we introduce a practical taxonomy of hand types based on the functioning perspective and utilize it for per-frame hand type labeling on existing datasets. We also propose a novel hand action recognition framework considering semantic details of the hand type as prior. This approach boosts the network's understanding of the continuous hand interaction throughout the action sequence. Our whole pipeline consists of three main modules: (1) Feature Extraction, (2) Egocentric Knowledge Module, which estimates 3D hand pose, object category, and hand type leveraging short-term cues, and (2) Egocentric Action Module, which aggregates per-frame knowledge, including text embeddings of hand type, over a longer time. In our extensive experiments with large-scale benchmarks, FPHA and H2O, our model outperforms current state-of-the-art methods, demonstrating its superior performance.
tldr: 该文提出基于功能性手型先验的自我中心视频手部动作识别框架，统一估计3D手姿、物体类别与手型并融合时序知识。
motivation: 现有自我中心视角动作识别方法仅依赖几何或物理信息，难以感知动态手部运动。本文关注功能性手部配置与物体的关联，以提升真实场景下细粒度手物交互理解。
method: 提出基于功能视角的手型分类体系，并对现有数据集进行逐帧手型标注；构建以手型语义为先验的动作识别框架，包含特征提取、利用短期线索估计3D手姿/物体类别/手型的Egocentric Knowledge Module，以及聚合逐帧知识（含手型文本嵌入）的Egocentric Action Module。
result: 在FPHA和H2O两个大规模基准上开展大量实验，模型性能优于当前最先进方法；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 引入功能性手型先验可增强对连续手物交互的理解，提升3D手姿估计与动作识别性能，为自我中心单目视频理解提供了新思路。

title: OTT3R: Multi-View 3D Reconstruction and Fast Dataset Generation at 1% Compute
abstract: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models have achieved impressive performance by scaling model and dataset size, but their cost excludes most research groups and precludes edge deployment. Additionally, generating 3D supervision without sensors still relies on slow, unreliable Structure-from-Motion, as the community lacks a COLMAP-like system for neural 3D pseudo-label generation. We present OTT3R (RGB-Only Tiny Transformer for 3D Reconstruction), a knowledge distillation framework that addresses both problems on a single workstation equipped with 2 GPUs. Distilling $π^3$ (959M parameters) into a 102M-parameter student yields 9.4$\times$ compression and up to 7$\times$ faster inference, trained at 1.6% of VGGT's training compute. An integrated pseudo-label pipeline offers a reliable, high-throughput alternative to COLMAP, generating dense per-pixel point maps and SE(3) camera poses for a 667K-image corpus in 3.5 hours on two commodity GPUs and succeeding on every sequence we tested, including those where COLMAP fails. The general student tracks the teacher on in-distribution monocular depth and, zero-shot, outperforms COLMAP on 7-Scenes and on DTU completion, but it does not replace the teacher on out-of-distribution multi-view geometry. The deployable artifact is the domain-specialized student: after specialization at 0.2% compute, it is 4$\times$ more accurate than COLMAP on 7-Scenes at 980$\times$ throughput, with near-teacher completion. Code is available at https://github.com/TheFourthKaramazov/OTT3R
tldr: OTT3R用知识蒸馏把π³压缩为102M学生模型，并以低算力生成3D伪标签。
motivation: 前馈3D重建模型依赖大规模模型与数据，训练成本高，难以被普通研究组使用和边缘部署；同时无传感器3D监督仍依赖缓慢且不可靠的COLMAP式SfM，缺少神经伪标签生成系统。
method: OTT3R是仅用RGB的轻量Transformer知识蒸馏框架，在双GPU工作站上将π³蒸馏为102M学生模型，并集成高吞吐伪标签流水线，为图像语料生成稠密逐像素点图和SE(3)相机位姿；还可对通用学生进行领域特化。
result: 蒸馏实现9.4倍压缩、最高7倍推理加速，训练算力仅为VGGT的1.6%；伪标签流水线在两张消费级GPU上3.5小时处理667K图像，并在所有测试序列（包括COLMAP失败序列）成功。通用学生在同分布单目深度上逼近教师，零样本在7-Scenes和DTU补全上优于COLMAP，但在分布外多视图几何上不能替代教师；领域特化学生仅用0.2%算力，在7-Scenes上比COLMAP准确4倍、吞吐量980倍，补全接近教师。
conclusion: OTT3R以单工作站双GPU实现了低成本多视图3D重建与快速数据集生成，提供了可靠的COLMAP替代方案，并释放可部署的领域特化学生模型；其局限是分布外多视图几何仍依赖教师模型。代码已开源，有望推动3D重建研究和边缘部署。

title: LeRF: Learning Reference Coordinate Frames for Perspective Taking Reasoning
abstract: Perspective taking is a fundamental component of spatial intelligence, requiring models interpret spatial relations from a specified viewpoint, such as that of another entity or an imagined observer. Despite the increasing spatial reasoning capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), they still struggle with perspective taking, often defaulting to the camera viewpoint when a query requires reasoning from a different perspective. We introduce Learning Reference Coordinate Frames for Perspective Taking (LeRF), a framework that trains VLMs to construct and use explicit reference frames for viewpoint-dependent reasoning. Given an image and a query, LeRF decides whether a coordinate frame is necessary. If so, it grounds the reference entity and predicts the frame's origin and entity-centered reference frame. A lightweight renderer overlays the frame onto the image, enabling subsequent reasoning over these visual cues without external perception models or explicit 3D reconstruction. To learn this process, we first perform supervised fine-tuning to teach selective tool invocation and reference coordinate frame prediction, followed by reinforcement learning on spatial VQA pairs to improve frame-guided reasoning. Across diverse perspective-taking benchmarks, LeRF consistently improves over its backbone and achieves strong performance against existing open-source methods. Further evaluations also show improved reference-frame grounding and orientation estimation, supporting the effectiveness of learned reference frames for viewpoint-dependent reasoning.
tldr: LeRF 让 VLM 按需构建并渲染参考坐标系，以强化视角依赖的空间推理。
motivation: 视觉语言模型在视角转换推理中常错误地默认相机视角，难以从他人或想象观察者的指定视角理解空间关系。为此，需要让模型显式构建并使用参考坐标系。
method: LeRF 首先判断查询是否需要坐标系；若需要，则定位参考实体并预测以实体为中心的坐标系原点与朝向。轻量渲染器将该坐标系叠加到图像上，使后续推理无需外部感知模型或显式 3D 重建。训练上先监督微调学习选择性调用工具和坐标帧预测，再基于空间 VQA 对进行强化学习以提升帧引导推理。
result: 在多个视角转换基准上，LeRF 持续优于其骨干模型，并在与现有开源方法比较中取得强性能；额外评估显示参考坐标系定位与朝向估计也有提升。
conclusion: 研究表明学习显式参考坐标系能有效支持视角依赖推理，为 VLM 空间智能提供可扩展的免显式 3D 重建方案。

title: Sparse-View Interpretable 3D Animal Behavior Representations for Neural Encoding and Decoding
abstract: A deeper understanding of brain function requires a precise, structured characterization of behavior.Yet, extracting behavioral representations from video in a form suitable for scientific analysis remains a fundamental challenge. Many prior studies represent behavior via pose estimation or nonlinear video embeddings. However, pose tracking discards rich information beyond predefined keypoints, while nonlinear video embeddings lack interpretability. We address this limitation with SABLE (Sparse-view Animal Behavior Latent Embeddings), a self-supervised framework that leverages a geometric inductive bias to learn behavior representations.By augmenting a multi-view transformer with priors from monocular depth and pose estimation, SABLE reconstructs 3D animal behavior from extremely sparse views while learning explicit 3D latent structure. Without ground-truth 3D labels, it reliably recovers 3D behavior from two-view videos, whereas state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods fail or yield degenerate solutions. Across the International Brain Lab and Cheese3D datasets, we demonstrate that SABLE learns 3D representations that match or exceed prior SOTA performance in neural encoding and decoding. Once pretrained across animals, SABLE serves as an off-the-shelf model that generalizes zero-shot to unseen animals without animal-specific calibration or retraining. Our method establishes 3D-aware video embeddings that capture complex behavior, opening new avenues for studying brain-behavior relationships.
tldr: SABLE利用几何归纳偏置，从稀疏双视角视频自监督学习可解释3D动物行为表征并提升神经编码解码。
motivation: 从视频中提取适合科学分析的行为表征仍是基本挑战：姿态估计会丢弃预定义关键点之外的丰富信息，而非线性视频嵌入缺乏可解释性。该研究旨在学习兼具3D结构、可解释性和跨动物泛化能力的行为表征。
method: 提出SABLE自监督框架，在多视角Transformer中引入单目深度与姿态估计先验，形成几何归纳偏置以从极稀疏视角重建3D动物行为并学习显式3D隐结构。该方法无需3D真值标签，即可从双视角视频中恢复3D行为。
result: 在International Brain Lab和Cheese3D数据集上，SABLE的3D表征在神经编码与解码任务中匹配或超越先前SOTA，而现有SOTA在双视角设定下失败或产生退化解。跨动物预训练后，SABLE可作为即用模型零样本泛化到未见动物，无需动物特定校准或重训练。
conclusion: SABLE建立了能捕获复杂行为的3D感知视频嵌入，为研究脑-行为关系提供了可解释、可泛化的新工具，并展示了稀疏视角下3D行为表征学习在神经科学中的潜力。

title: GenNVS: Geometry-enhanced Novel View Synthesis via Disentangled 3D Prior
abstract: Single-image novel view synthesis remains challenging because the underlying 3D geometry is highly ambiguous. Recent diffusion-based approaches produce plausible results, but they often struggle to preserve the geometric structure and spatial coherence of foreground objects. We present GenNVS, a framework for geometry-enhanced novel view synthesis via a disentangled 3D prior. Specifically, GenNVS models foreground objects and the background with 3D Gaussian Splatting and aligns them through a coarse-to-fine geometric optimization process to form a unified 3D scene. This scene conditions a video diffusion model through the proposed Dual-Stream Masking mechanism, which guides synthesis by jointly exploiting rendered validity masks and geometry-aware warping. Experimental results show that GenNVS performs favorably against recent methods in both visual quality and geometric accuracy, while naturally supporting flexible scene editing.
tldr: GenNVS利用解耦3D先验与双流掩码增强单图新视角合成的几何一致性和空间连贯性。
motivation: 单图像新视角合成因底层3D几何高度模糊而困难；现有扩散方法虽能生成看似合理的结果，却难以保持前景物体的几何结构和空间连贯性。
method: GenNVS用3D Gaussian Splatting分别建模前景物体与背景，并通过由粗到细的几何优化对齐为统一3D场景；随后利用Dual-Stream Masking机制，结合渲染有效性掩码与几何感知变形来条件化视频扩散模型，引导新视角合成。
result: 实验表明，GenNVS在视觉质量和几何精度上均优于近期方法，并能自然支持灵活的场景编辑；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作提出一种基于解耦3D先验的几何增强新视角合成框架，提升了单图新视角合成的几何保真度与编辑能力，对可控3D内容生成具有潜在影响。

title: Sparse-View Interpretable 3D Animal Behavior Representations for Neural Encoding and Decoding
abstract: A deeper understanding of brain function requires a precise, structured characterization of behavior. Yet, extracting behavioral representations from video in a form suitable for scientific analysis remains a fundamental challenge. Many prior studies represent behavior via pose estimation or nonlinear video embeddings. However, pose tracking discards rich information beyond predefined keypoints, while nonlinear video embeddings lack interpretability. We address this limitation with SABLE (Sparse-view Animal Behavior Latent Embeddings), a self-supervised framework that leverages a geometric inductive bias to learn behavior representations. By augmenting a multi-view transformer with priors from monocular depth and pose estimation, SABLE reconstructs 3D animal behavior from extremely sparse views while learning explicit 3D latent structure. Without ground-truth 3D labels, it reliably recovers 3D behavior from two-view videos, whereas state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods fail or yield degenerate solutions. Across the International Brain Lab and Cheese3D datasets, we demonstrate that SABLE learns 3D representations that match or exceed prior SOTA performance in neural encoding and decoding. Once pretrained across animals, SABLE serves as an off-the-shelf model that generalizes zero-shot to unseen animals without animal-specific calibration or retraining. Our method establishes 3D-aware video embeddings that capture complex behavior, opening new avenues for studying brain-behavior relationships.
tldr: SABLE通过稀疏视角自监督学习可解释3D动物行为表示，提升神经编码解码并零样本泛化。
motivation: 精确结构化地表征行为是理解脑功能的关键，但从视频中提取适合科学分析的行为表示仍很困难。现有姿态估计会丢失预设关键点之外的信息，而非线性视频嵌入缺乏可解释性。
method: 提出SABLE自监督框架，利用几何归纳偏置学习行为表示。该方法在多视角Transformer中引入单目深度和姿态估计先验，从极稀疏视角重建3D动物行为，并在无真实3D标签下学习显式3D潜结构，仅用双视角视频可靠恢复3D行为。
result: 在International Brain Lab和Cheese3D数据集上，SABLE学到的3D表示在神经编码和解码中达到或超过此前SOTA；SOTA方法在双视角设定下失败或产生退化解。跨动物预训练后，SABLE无需动物特定校准或重训练即可零样本泛化到未见动物。
conclusion: SABLE建立了能捕捉复杂行为的三维感知视频嵌入，为研究脑-行为关系开辟新途径。其贡献在于兼具可解释性、稀疏视角鲁棒性和零样本泛化能力。

title: Rate-Distortion Adaptive Primitive Selection for Omnidirectional Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Learned image codecs (LICs) achieve high reconstruction quality, but their decoding speed is often insufficient for immersive virtual reality (VR). Gaussian splatting (GS) codecs render much faster, yet still lag in reconstruction quality and typically decide primitive allocation without considering the coding cost of each primitive. We introduce OIC-GS, an omnidirectional GS codec with a new hierarchical HEALPix primitive grid representation. Gaussian primitives are anchored at predefined spherical locations, eliminating explicit coordinate coding. Finer levels refine their coarser ancestors, naturally supporting coarse-to-fine reconstruction and layered transmission. The predefined grid also enables efficient viewport decoding by selecting only view-relevant primitives. We further introduce a lightweight entropy model for quantized primitives and optimize the codec under a spherical rate-distortion objective. Primitives with insufficient rate-distortion benefit are automatically removed when their quantized opacity becomes zero, allowing OIC-GS to adapt both primitive density and level of detail without a fixed primitive budget. A single bitstream supports full-sphere, viewport-dependent, and progressive decoding. The first viewport reaches final quality after decoding only 52% of the bitstream, and is then rendered at 1,270 FPS. On a 100-image omnidirectional benchmark, OIC-GS outperforms all evaluated GS codecs, reducing WS-PSNR BD-rate by 49.6% over GaussianImage++ and 68.6% over SGI, which uses a learned entropy model.
tldr: OIC-GS：分层HEALPix网格与率失真自适应剪枝的全景高斯泼溅编解码器，支持视口和渐进解码。
motivation: 学习图像编解码器重建质量高但解码速度难以满足沉浸式VR；高斯泼溅编解码器渲染更快，却重建质量落后，且通常不考虑每个基元的编码代价来分配基元。为此，论文研究面向全景高斯泼溅的率失真自适应基元选择与编解码。
method: 提出OIC-GS，采用分层HEALPix基元网格将高斯基元锚定在预定义球面位置，省去显式坐标编码，细层级优化粗层级祖先以支持由粗到细重建和分层传输。引入轻量熵模型对量化基元建模，并在球面率失真目标下优化；当量化不透明度为零时自动移除率失真收益不足的基元，实现无固定基元预算的自适应密度和细节层次。单个比特流支持全球面、视口相关和渐进解码。
result: 首个视口仅需解码52%比特流即可达到最终质量，随后渲染速度达1,270 FPS。在包含100张图像的全景基准上，OIC-GS优于所有评估的GS编解码器，相比GaussianImage++和SGI分别将WS-PSNR BD-rate降低49.6%和68.6%，其中SGI使用了学习熵模型。
conclusion: OIC-GS通过率失真自适应基元选择与分层球面网格，在保持高压缩效率的同时实现快速视口解码和多模式传输。其贡献在于统一支持全球面、视口相关和渐进解码，为沉浸式VR中的全景高斯泼溅压缩提供了新方案。

title: Gaussian Splatting-based Volumetric Video Compression with Sparse 4D Anchors
abstract: Immersive video communication requires photorealistic, render-efficient, and compact dynamic scene representations. 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) offers a promising representation, but dynamic 3DGS remains difficult to compress due to dense primitives and spatiotemporal redundancy. Anchor-based formulations improve compactness with sparse scaffolds that share geometry and appearance across primitives. However, existing designs often rely on deforming a single canonical scaffold and condition each primitive on its associated anchor in isolation, limiting their ability to handle non-local dynamics and disocclusion while under-exploiting inter-anchor correlations, particularly in motion- or texture-dense regions. To address these limitations, we propose SAGA, a volumetric video codec built upon Sparse Anchor-assisted GAussian splatting representations. SAGA represents dynamic 3D scenes using hierarchically organized sparse 4D anchors, where coordinate-based INR decoders generate fine anchors and Gaussian primitives from inter-anchor interpolations, enabling compact parameter sharing across spatiotemporal structures. For long-range dependencies among unstructured anchors, we further introduce fixed-size memory slots with orthogonality-informed updates for accurate entropy-context modeling. Experiments show that SAGA achieves strong rate-distortion performance against GIFStream, with PSNR BD-rate reductions of 80.39% and 83.94% on Neu3D and MPEG MIV, respectively.
tldr: 提出SAGA，基于稀疏4D锚点与INR插值的动态3DGS体积视频压缩，显著降低码率。
motivation: 动态3DGS因基元密集和时空冗余难以压缩；现有锚点方法依赖单一规范模板变形、孤立锚点条件建模，难以处理非局部运动与去遮挡，且未充分利用锚点间相关性。
method: SAGA用分层稀疏4D锚点表示动态场景，由坐标INR解码器通过锚点间插值生成精细锚点与高斯基元，实现参数共享；并引入固定大小记忆槽与正交性更新进行熵上下文建模，捕获非结构锚点长程依赖。
result: 在Neu3D和MPEG MIV上，SAGA相比GIFStream取得更强率失真性能，PSNR BD-rate分别降低80.39%和83.94%。
conclusion: SAGA证明稀疏4D锚点与记忆熵建模可有效压缩动态3DGS，为沉浸式视频通信提供紧凑、可渲染的动态场景表示，并显著优于现有锚点方法。

title: EpiTransfer: Sparse, Training-Free Long-Range Depth Estimation from Temporal Monocular Aerial Frames
abstract: Reliable 3D spatial understanding is essential for autonomous navigation, obstacle avoidance, and scene reconstruction. While state-of-the-art learned depth estimation techniques achieve high accuracy in-distribution, they often generalize poorly to novel viewpoints and altitudes. This paper presents a geometrically derived, training-free depth estimation method using epipolar transfer with only two monocular images and camera pose estimates. By leveraging camera motion to synthesize a virtual stereo pair with a freely chosen baseline, our approach transforms temporal correspondence into a stereo triangulation task while mitigating geometric degeneracies inherent to direct two-view triangulation. Validated across outdoor drone flights (to a maximum range of approximately 90\,m) and indoor OptiTrack environments against LiDAR ground truth, the method achieves an indoor AbsRel of 0.092 and $δ< 1.25$ of 0.940, comparable to direct triangulation (AbsRel 0.073) while retaining valid depth over a larger fraction of challenging scenes, and substantially outperforms off-the-shelf learning-based baselines such as ZoeDepth (AbsRel 0.225) and Depth Anything V2 (AbsRel 0.570), which are not trained or fine-tuned for this domain, with no training data required.
tldr: 提出免训练的长程单目航拍深度估计，利用极线迁移合成虚拟立体对，在无人机与室内数据上优于深度学习基线。
motivation: 自主导航、避障与场景重建需要可靠的三维空间理解，但现有学习式深度估计虽在同分布内精度高，却对新颖视角和高度泛化差。
method: EpiTransfer仅用两张单目图像和相机位姿估计，通过相机运动合成具有自由基线的虚拟立体对，将时间对应转化为立体三角化，并缓解直接双视图三角化的几何退化。
result: 在户外无人机（最远约90 m）与室内OptiTrack环境中以LiDAR为真值验证，EpiTransfer室内AbsRel达0.092、δ<1.25达0.940，与直接三角化（AbsRel 0.073）相当且在困难场景中有效深度占比更高；显著优于未针对该域训练/微调的ZoeDepth（AbsRel 0.225）和Depth Anything V2（AbsRel 0.570）。
conclusion: EpiTransfer无需训练数据即可实现稀疏长程深度估计，对新颖航拍视角与高度具有更好泛化，为无人机自主导航和场景重建提供实用方案。

title: Robot-GST: geometry-aware spatial-temporal robot policy representation and evaluation
abstract: Robotic manipulation policies are advancing rapidly with increasing reliance on vision-language models for end-to-end decision making. However, reliable deployment remains challenging because many policies lack explicit mechanisms for predicting task outcomes and evaluating whether generated actions will achieve desired final states, causing execution errors to accumulate during long-horizon manipulation. We present Robot-GST, a geometry-aware spatio-temporal behaviour representation and evaluation framework that constructs a Gaussian-SAM robotic environment for real-to-sim policy verification and improves the reliability of real-world manipulation deployment. Our approach constructs a high-fidelity robotic environment from RGB-D observations using 3D Gaussian Splatting and SAM3D, enabling ``simulation and evaluation before acting''. It integrates visual observations and language instructions with spatio-temporal reasoning for long-horizon task planning using large vision-language models. To bridge high-level planning and real-world execution, we introduce Gaussian-aware final-state estimation through geometric sampling and state-based trajectory planning. Before execution, candidate action sequences are simulated and evaluated in the Gaussian-SAM environment to filter infeasible behaviours. We validate our approach on representative manipulation tasks involving rigid, soft, and deformable objects, including cube placing, toy packing, and duck rearrangement, demonstrating that geometry-aware spatio-temporal reasoning and state-aware execution improve manipulation reliability across different object categories. Our results suggest that combining geometry-aware reconstruction with high-quality rendering and simulation provides a scalable approach for evaluating robotic manipulation behaviours. Website: https://robot-gst.github.io
tldr: Robot-GST通过Gaussian-SAM环境在动作前仿真评估，提升长时程操作可靠性。
motivation: 机器人操作策略日益依赖视觉语言模型进行端到端决策，但许多策略缺乏显式的结果预测与动作评估机制，导致长时程操作中执行误差不断累积，可靠部署仍很困难。
method: 从RGB-D观测出发，利用3D Gaussian Splatting与SAM3D构建高保真Gaussian-SAM机器人环境，实现真实到仿真的策略验证；结合视觉观测与语言指令进行时空推理和长时程任务规划，并引入基于几何采样的最终状态估计与状态轨迹规划。执行前，候选动作序列会在Gaussian-SAM环境中仿真评估，以过滤不可行行为。
result: 在刚体、软体和可变形物体的代表性操作任务上验证，包括方块放置、玩具打包和鸭子重排，表明几何感知时空推理与状态感知执行提升了不同物体类别的操作可靠性；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 结果表明，将几何感知重建与高质量渲染和仿真相结合，为评估机器人操作行为提供了可扩展方案，并有助于提升真实世界操作部署的可靠性。

title: FeCoSplat: Feedback-Guided Compression for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables efficient novel-view synthesis from sparse multi-view images, yet its representations remain costly to store and transmit. Existing approaches compress either the input images, incurring heavy receiver-side reconstruction, or the reconstructed Gaussian primitives, which are difficult to compress due to their heterogeneous and irregular attributes. We instead compress compact intermediate features, providing a better balance between compression efficiency and receiver-side complexity. Based on this paradigm, we propose FeCoSplat, a feedback-guided compression framework for feed-forward 3DGS. FeCoSplat first compresses multi-view features to obtain an intermediate 3DGS, whose rendered views are used as feedback to guide a second-stage compression for further refinement. The resulting bitstreams are decoded into a compact implicit state, from which the final Gaussian primitives are reconstructed with a lightweight predictor. Experiments demonstrate that FeCoSplat achieves favorable rate--distortion performance, particularly at low bitrates, while requiring only 3.45M parameters for receiver-side Gaussian reconstruction. Code will be released soon.
tldr: FeCoSplat通过反馈引导压缩紧凑中间特征，实现高效前馈3DGS存储传输与低码率高质量重建。
motivation: 前馈3DGS能从稀疏多视图高效合成新视角，但其表示存储和传输成本高。现有方法或压缩输入图像导致接收端重建负担重，或压缩异构不规则的高斯原语而难以高效压缩。
method: 提出FeCoSplat，一种反馈引导的前馈3DGS压缩框架：先压缩多视图特征得到中间3DGS，并用其渲染视图作为反馈指导第二阶段压缩以进一步细化；最终码流被解码为紧凑隐状态，再由轻量预测器重建最终高斯原语。
result: 实验表明FeCoSplat取得良好的率失真性能，尤其在低码率下优势明显，同时接收端高斯重建仅需3.45M参数。
conclusion: FeCoSplat在压缩效率与接收端复杂度之间实现了更好平衡，为前馈3DGS压缩提供了新范式，代码将发布。

title: VGGT-Diff: Visual Geometry Meets Diffusion for Sparse-View Novel View Synthesis
abstract: We present VGGT-Diff, a geometry-routed multi-view diffusion model for sparse-view novel view synthesis. Existing novel view synthesis (NVS) methods face a fundamental trade-off: reconstruction-based approaches preserve observed geometry but struggle to synthesize unseen regions, while diffusion-based methods provide strong generative priors yet rely on implicit source-to-query correspondence. VGGT-Diff bridges these regimes by routing visual geometry latents from VGGT-Ω into a pretrained video diffusion model. Each visual token is associated with a 3D point and confidence, then transformed into query-aligned latent conditions through a confidence-aware Visual Geometry Router (VGR) that preserves front and back surface evidence. These conditions guide joint target-view denoising, while Point-Track Residual Consistency (PTRC) regularizes predicted-clean residuals along reliable 3D tracks, improving multi-view stability. We further introduce robust geometry conditioning, combining training-time regularization with inference-time guidance for improved robustness. Experiments show competitive or state-of-the-art performance across interpolation and extrapolation under different viewpoint difficulties. Our code is available at https://github.com/chenkangjie1123/VGGT-Diff.
tldr: VGGT-Diff 将 VGGT 视觉几何潜变量路由到视频扩散模型，提升稀疏视角新视图合成。
motivation: 现有新视图合成方法面临重建与生成的权衡：重建方法能保留观测几何但难以合成未见区域，扩散方法生成先验强却依赖隐式源到查询对应关系。VGGT-Diff 旨在桥接两类范式，解决稀疏视角下几何一致性与生成质量的矛盾。
method: 该方法将 VGGT-Ω 的视觉几何潜变量路由进预训练视频扩散模型，每个视觉 token 关联 3D 点与置信度，并通过置信度感知的 Visual Geometry Router（VGR）转换为查询对齐的潜条件，同时保留前后面证据。这些条件引导联合目标视角去噪，Point-Track Residual Consistency（PTRC）沿可靠 3D 轨迹正则化预测的干净残差以提升多视角稳定性，此外结合训练时正则化与推理时引导实现鲁棒几何条件。
result: 实验表明，该方法在不同视角难度下的插值和外推任务中取得有竞争力或最先进的性能。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: VGGT-Diff 通过几何路由的多视角扩散框架统一了几何重建与生成先验，提升了稀疏视角新视图合成的鲁棒性与多视角一致性。其代码已开源，有望推动几何感知扩散模型在三维视觉中的应用。

title: VPTwin: Real-Sim-Real Video Prediction for Robotic Manipulation Planning
abstract: While action-conditioned video prediction provides an intuitive world model for robotics, purely data-driven predictors often suffer from compounding errors and physically implausible hallucinations in long-horizon rollouts, severely undermining downstream action planning. We propose VPTwin, a Real-Sim-Real video prediction framework that anchors real-world future prediction using real-synchronized simulation twins. For a target manipulation task, a VLM reconstructs an executable digital twin from a real demonstration episode. To accommodate the ill-posed estimation of unobserved physical properties, Isaac Sim simulates multiple forward dynamic rollouts across randomized physical configurations under candidate action trajectories. Using these rollouts as in-context references, VPTwin harmonizes both domains, using simulation dynamics to enforce physical plausibility while capturing unmodeled contact interactions from real video. Furthermore, we establish a predictive planning loop using VPTwin to visually verify VLM-proposed actions and guide reliable real-world execution. Evaluations show substantial reductions in physical hallucinations during video prediction and marked improvements in manipulation planning performance.
tldr: VPTwin通过真实-仿真-真实视频预测，以仿真孪生约束物理合理性并提升机器人操作规划可靠性。
motivation: 动作条件视频预测可作为机器人直观世界模型，但纯数据驱动方法在长时程推演中易产生累积误差和物理上不合理的幻觉，严重损害下游动作规划。
method: VPTwin构建真实-仿真-真实预测框架：VLM从真实示范中重建可执行数字孪生，Isaac Sim在候选动作与随机物理配置下进行多组前向动力学推演，并将其作为上下文参考，融合仿真动力学约束与真实视频中未建模接触交互。进一步建立预测规划闭环，用VPTwin视觉验证VLM提出的动作以指导真实世界执行。
result: 评估显示视频预测中的物理幻觉显著减少，操作规划性能明显提升；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: VPTwin将同步仿真孪生与真实视频预测结合，提高了长时程预测的物理合理性和规划可靠性，有望推动机器人世界模型与操作规划的实际部署。

title: Unlocking Geodesic Gromov-Wasserstein Distances for 3D Modeling
abstract: \textit{Gromov-Wasserstein Distances} (GWDs) provide quantitative ways of comparing probabilistic distributions defined on different metric spaces by applying techniques from the optimal transport theory. As such, GWD can be potentially useful in a large variety of applications ranging from graph matching problems to 3D object detection. However its practical use at scale is significantly limited by cubic time complexity computations involving dense intra-space distance matrices. Even though in the Euclidean metric spaces several techniques (e.g. involving scalable kernel methods) were proposed to address it, to the best of our knowledge, analogous techniques for general geodesic distances on manifolds, or shortest-path distance on graphs in their discretized variants, were not developed. In this paper, we present \textbf{E}fficient \textbf{G}eodesic \textbf{Gro}mov-\textbf{W}asserstein methods (EGGroW), a new class of efficient algorithms designed to calculate geodesic Gromov-Wasserstein distances with entropic Sinkhorn-like approaches, leveraging recently introduced \textit{GenusSink} methods \citep{genussink} and the theory of random features. We provide important downstream applications, namely: 3D pose estimation and 3D template detection. In the latter setting, we formulate a partial 3D template recovery as a staged problem: capacity-constrained scene selection is followed by semi-relaxed recovery of template visibility and correspondence. Our empirical findings show that EGGroW provides accurate solutions when standard Euclidean-based techniques fail and is characterized by light computational footprint, as our theoretical analysis predicts.
tldr: 提出EGGroW，用熵Sinkhorn与随机特征高效计算测地Gromov-Wasserstein距离，用于3D姿态与模板检测。
motivation: Gromov-Wasserstein距离可用于比较不同度量空间上的概率分布，在圖匹配与3D物体检测中潜力大，但稠密空间内距离矩阵导致三次时间复杂度，严重限制其规模化应用。欧氏空间已有可扩展核方法，而一般流形测地距离或图最短路径距离尚无类似高效技术。
method: 本文提出EGGroW，一类高效算法，结合熵Sinkhorn式方法与随机特征理论，并借助GenusSink方法计算测地Gromov-Wasserstein距离。针对部分3D模板恢复，将其形式化为两阶段问题：先做容量受限的场景选择，再做半松弛的模板可见性与对应恢复。
result: 实验表明EGGroW在标准欧氏方法失效时仍能给出准确解，且计算开销轻量，与理论分析一致；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: EGGroW为一般测地距离及图最短路径距离上的Gromov-Wasserstein计算提供了高效方案，并成功应用于3D姿态估计与3D模板检测，有望推动大规模3D建模与匹配任务。

title: ProDyGS: Dynamic Gaussian Splatting from a Single Static Monocular Camera
abstract: We present ProDyGS, a novel dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for high-quality novel view synthesis from videos captured by a single static camera. While existing methods rely on multi-view setups or significant camera motion for geometric constraints, our approach addresses the challenging scenario where multi-view supervision is completely absent. We overcome this limitation by generating synthetic multi-view supervision through depth-guided proxy image synthesis. Specifically, we estimate temporally consistent depth maps using foundational monocular depth networks, then construct 3D Gaussian representations that generate proxy images from arbitrary viewpoints. A deformation network learns temporal dynamics by warping canonical Gaussians using this augmented supervision. Experiments on the DyNeRF dataset demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance while requiring only monocular depth estimation as external supervision, outperforming approaches that rely on stronger priors such as scene flow.
tldr: ProDyGS 利用单目深度生成伪多视角监督，实现单静置相机视频的动态高斯泼溅新视角合成。
motivation: 现有动态新视角合成方法通常依赖多视角相机或显著相机运动提供几何约束，难以处理单台静止单目相机拍摄且缺乏多视角监督的场景。本文旨在仅凭单目视频与单目深度估计，实现高质量动态三维新视角合成。
method: 方法先利用基础单目深度网络估计时序一致的深度图，并通过深度引导代理图像合成生成伪多视角监督；再构建3D高斯表示以从任意视角渲染代理图像，并用变形网络在增广监督下对规范高斯进行warping以学习时序动态。
result: 在DyNeRF数据集上，ProDyGS达到最先进性能，且仅需单目深度估计作为外部监督，性能优于依赖scene flow等更强先验的方法。
conclusion: 结果表明，单静态单目相机视频也能实现动态高斯泼溅新视角合成，降低了对多视角采集与强先验的依赖，为单目动态场景重建提供了可行路线。

title: World SLAM Model: Joint World Modeling for SLAM and Navigation
abstract: We introduce World SLAM Model (WSM), a unified framework that brings the SLAM paradigm directly into downstream navigation. Rather than treating SLAM merely as an upstream module that provides poses, maps or tokens, WSM adopts its core mechanisms, including incremental state updates with persistent memory and backend refinement of accumulated errors, to maintain a consistent world state during interaction. Given the current observation and a navigation goal, WSM predicts future visual states and jointly estimates their camera motion and dense geometry, grounding visual prediction in an evolving spatial world state. This spatial state is continuously updated as new observations arrive and provides the basis for action generation and closed-loop navigation. WSM is trained end-to-end with a joint navigation--SLAM objective, enabling downstream navigation to benefit directly from SLAM-style state maintenance and refinement while preserving accurate geometric estimation. Experiments demonstrate improved navigation performance together with strong SLAM accuracy, highlighting the potential of SLAM as an intrinsic mechanism for long-horizon world modeling and embodied interaction.
tldr: WSM将SLAM增量状态更新与后端优化融入导航，联合预测未来视觉、估计相机运动与密集几何。
motivation: 现有方法多将SLAM视为仅提供位姿、地图或token的上游模块，导致其状态维护与误差优化能力无法直接用于下游导航，难以在长时程交互中保持世界状态一致。WSM旨在把SLAM范式内嵌到导航中，解决导航与几何估计割裂的问题。
method: WSM引入SLAM的增量状态更新、持久记忆和后端累积误差优化，在给定当前观测与导航目标时预测未来视觉状态，并联合估计相机运动与密集几何，将视觉预测锚定在持续演化的空间世界状态上。该状态随新观测不断更新，用于动作生成与闭环导航，并以导航-SLAM联合目标端到端训练。
result: 实验显示WSM在提升导航性能的同时保持较强的SLAM精度；摘要未提供具体量化指标、数据集或基线对比细节。
conclusion: WSM表明SLAM可作为长时程世界建模与具身交互的内在机制，其统一框架和联合训练目标让导航直接受益于SLAM式状态维护与后端优化。该工作为世界模型、闭环导航与SLAM的深度融合提供了新思路。

title: QuacamFM: Quaternion-Constrained Flow Matching for Camera Pose Estimation
abstract: Camera pose estimation from multi-view images remains a challenge in computer vision. Traditional methods often address this problem using Structure-from-Motion (SfM) with bundle adjustment. However, camera poses estimated from sparse views are inherently ambiguous due to insufficient geometric constraints. Recent work leverages probabilistic models, such as diffusion models, to generate multiple camera pose hypotheses and therefore capture this uncertainty better. Most of these methods represent camera rotations using unit quaternions, but treat them as unconstrained 4D vectors during the generative processes, thereby ignoring the unit-norm constraint of quaternions. Unconstrained quaternions create non-smooth and suboptimal generation trajectories. To this end, we propose *QuacamFM*, a quaternion-constrained flow matching framework for camera pose estimation that preserves unit quaternion representations throughout the entire flow trajectory. We design the optimal transport of the quaternion flows using smooth spherical linear interpolation. Experiments on CO3Dv2 demonstrate our method's advantage in camera pose accuracy over diffusion-based methods and classical SfM approaches. We further show that our quaternion-constrained formulation outperforms the naive application of standard flow matching to 4D quaternion vectors on sparse-view camera pose estimation. Finally, it is observed that QuacamFM generalizes well across datasets and in-the-wild examples.
tldr: 提出四元数约束流匹配框架QuacamFM，在完整流轨迹保持单位四元数，提升稀疏视角相机位姿估计精度。
motivation: 多视图相机位姿估计中，稀疏视角因几何约束不足导致位姿歧义。现有扩散等概率方法虽能生成多个位姿假设以建模不确定性，但多数将相机旋转的单位四元数当作无约束4D向量处理，忽略单位范数约束，造成生成轨迹不平滑且次优。
method: 提出QuacamFM，一种四元数约束流匹配框架，在整个流轨迹中始终保留单位四元数表示。该方法利用平滑球面线性插值（SLERP）设计四元数流的最优传输路径，从而在生成过程中显式满足单位范数约束。
result: 在CO3Dv2上，QuacamFM的相机位姿精度优于基于扩散的方法和经典SfM方法；在稀疏视角相机位姿估计中，也优于将标准流匹配直接应用于4D四元数向量的朴素做法。摘要未提供具体量化指标，并显示该方法可跨数据集及野外样例泛化。
conclusion: 四元数约束流匹配能有效保持旋转表示的单位范数特性，改善生成轨迹质量与相机位姿估计精度，为稀疏视角位姿估计提供优于扩散模型和经典SfM的新方案，并展现出良好的跨数据集与野外泛化潜力。

title: Endo-TSR: Temporal Spectral Modeling of Appearance and Motion for Endoscopic Reconstruction
abstract: Endoscopic scene reconstruction requires modeling tissue motion and temporal appearance while recovering fine surface detail. Deformable Gaussian models provide explicit trajectories, but their fixed colour coefficients lack a dedicated temporal representation for photometric changes. We propose Endo-TSR, which augments deformable Gaussian splatting with bounded Fourier colour residuals and independent translation residuals on shared temporal frequencies. The colour residuals capture local appearance changes, while a Matérn spectral prior regularises motion corrections. Multi-scale Laplacian supervision guides tissue-detail recovery during joint image fitting. Extensive experiments on the EndoNeRF and StereoMIS datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art rendering quality, with the highest PSNR across all evaluated sequences. Ablation studies show that temporal appearance yields the largest PSNR gain among the tested component additions, while appearance and detail supervision jointly improve rendering with fixed Gaussian counts.
tldr: Endo-TSR通过有界傅里叶颜色残差与Matérn谱先验增强可变形高斯，实现内窥镜场景高质量时序重建。
motivation: 内窥镜场景重建需同时建模组织运动、时变外观并恢复精细表面细节。可变形高斯模型虽提供显式轨迹，但其固定颜色系数缺乏面向光度变化的专用时序表示。
method: Endo-TSR在可变形高斯泼溅上引入有界傅里叶颜色残差与共享时间频率的独立平移残差，以颜色残差捕捉局部外观变化，并用Matérn谱先验正则化运动修正。联合图像拟合中采用多尺度拉普拉斯监督引导组织细节恢复。
result: 在EndoNeRF和StereoMIS数据集上取得最优渲染质量，在所有评估序列中获得最高PSNR。消融实验表明，时序外观在测试组件中带来最大PSNR增益，且外观与细节监督在固定高斯数量下共同提升渲染效果。
conclusion: Endo-TSR通过显式时序频谱建模颜色与运动，提升了内窥镜动态重建的保真度。其贡献在于为可变形高斯引入时序外观/运动表示、谱先验正则与细节监督，有望推动内窥镜场景高质量重建研究。

title: FoundDSR: A Generalizable Foundation Model with Guided 2D Gaussian Splatting for Depth Super-Resolution
abstract: We introduce FoundDSR, a generalizable foundation model for robust depth reconstruction across unseen data distributions using RGB-D pairs. FoundDSR begins with a guided 2D Gaussian Splatting strategy to model depth representations with Gaussian primitives. This strategy employs high-resolution RGB as prompts to optimize the Gaussian parameters, thereby encouraging each Gaussian primitive to anisotropically deform along high-frequency structural directions. The resulting Gaussian-upsampled representations are then mapped to high-resolution depth through an effective depth reconstruction branch. Furthermore, to mitigate training instability and bias toward dominant sources caused by distribution gaps in large-scale heterogeneous data, we introduce heterogeneous federated learning that allocates each data source to an independent client for local optimization and global aggregation. This design effectively endows FoundDSR with stable scalability to diverse and large-scale training data. Extensive zero-shot evaluations on synthetic, real-world, arbitrary-scale, and noisy conditions demonstrate that FoundDSR consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches, confirming its strong robustness and generalization to unknown scenes.
tldr: 提出FoundDSR，用引导2D高斯泼溅与异构联邦学习实现可泛化深度超分辨率。
motivation: 旨在解决跨未见数据分布的鲁棒深度重建与深度超分辨率泛化问题。大规模异构训练数据存在分布差距，易导致训练不稳定并偏向主导数据源。
method: 以高分辨率RGB为提示，采用引导2D高斯泼溅建模深度表示，优化高斯参数使其沿高频结构方向各向异性变形，再经深度重建分支映射为高分辨率深度。同时引入异构联邦学习，将每个数据源作为独立客户端进行本地优化与全局聚合。
result: 在合成、真实、任意尺度及噪声条件下的广泛零样本评测中，FoundDSR一致优于现有最先进方法；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 贡献在于提出可泛化基础模型，结合引导2D高斯泼溅与异构联邦学习，实现对多样大规模训练数据的稳定扩展。该工作验证了对未知场景的强鲁棒性与泛化潜力。

title: Federated 3D Gaussian Splatting for Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction at Wireless Edge
abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) Gaussian splatting (3D-GS) has emerged as a promising technique for large-scale scene reconstruction due to its high rendering efficiency and fidelity. However, the training of large-scale 3D-GS models at wireless edge faces various technical challenges including the limited communication, computation, and graphics processing unit (GPU) memory resources at edge devices, the structural inconsistency issue across local models hindering their effective aggregation, as well as privacy leakage risks associated with raw visual content and camera parameters. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel resource-efficient federated learning framework for efficiently training 3D-GS models of large scenes under severe resource constraints. First, we propose an on-device model lightweighting mechanism that adaptively selects and prunes Gaussian points to balance the rendering quality and training efficiency. In this mechanism, we quantitatively evaluate the importance of different Gaussian points at each device to facilitate the pruning, and use a novel importance-to-latency ratio criterion to determine the number of pruned Gaussian points under GPU memory and computation/communication latency constraints. Furthermore, we develop a 3D-GS model recovery mechanism that restores structural consistency across local 3D-GS models without accessing private camera parameters, enabling their effective aggregation towards a global model. Finally, extensive experiments show that our approach significantly accelerates convergence, maintains high rendering quality, and reduces training latency compared to state-of-the-art federated 3D-GS baselines.
tldr: 提出面向无线边缘的资源高效联邦3D-GS框架，通过轻量化、结构恢复与隐私保护实现大规模场景重建。
motivation: 大规模3D-GS模型在无线边缘训练时受限于边缘设备的通信、计算与GPU内存资源，同时本地模型间存在结构不一致导致聚合困难，原始视觉内容和相机参数还带来隐私泄露风险。
method: 提出资源高效的联邦学习框架：在设备端自适应选择与剪枝高斯点，量化高斯点重要性，并基于重要性-时延比准则在GPU内存及计算/通信时延约束下确定剪枝数量；进一步设计3D-GS模型恢复机制，在不访问私有相机参数的情况下恢复本地模型间的结构一致性，以实现有效聚合。
result: 大量实验表明，该方法相比现有最先进的联邦3D-GS基线显著加速收敛、保持高渲染质量并降低训练时延；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作为无线边缘环境下大规模3D-GS训练提供了一种兼顾资源效率、结构一致性与隐私保护的新型联邦学习方案，有望推动边缘大规模场景重建的实际部署。

title: OneFixer: High-Quality and Consistent One-Step Autoregressive 3DGS Refinement for Driving Scenes
abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion is a promising render-time fixer for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) in autonomous-driving simulation, but deployment demands high visual quality and temporal consistency at low latency. This is especially hard for one-step causal generation, where each imperfect prediction immediately becomes context for subsequent frames. Existing approaches stabilize rollouts through staged training with multiple modules and rollout-aware regularization, yet one-step quality still falls short of what deployment requires. We introduce OneFixer, a one-step autoregressive video-diffusion fixer trained in a single task-specific adaptation stage. Our key idea is a deployment-matched shared rollout: the model's own one-step predictions serve as the causal context for flow matching, exposing training to deployment-time errors, while the same rollout receives direct pixel-space perceptual supervision to preserve fine detail. Because the predictions optimized for current-frame quality are exactly those reused as future context, fidelity and autoregressive robustness are learned jointly, without bidirectional-to-causal conversion or teacher-student distillation. OneFixer further exploits cues that driving simulation readily provides, lane geometry and dynamic-agent states, to improve geometric fidelity. On Waymo and proprietary driving scenes with 900-frame rollouts, OneFixer achieves the lowest FVD, LPIPS, and DISTS among all baselines at one step, with temporal consistency matching or exceeding multi-stage DMD pipelines. Under identical backbone and conditioning, it matches a multi-stage DMD-with-Self-Forcing pipeline in under half the GPU-hours and keeps improving beyond its plateau. In closed-loop simulation with a driving policy, OneFixer reduces the collision rate by a third relative to raw 3DGS rendering. Project page: https://onefixer-web.vercel.app/
tldr: OneFixer：单阶段训练的单步自回归视频扩散修复器，用共享 rollout 同时提升 3DGS 驾驶场景的保真度与时序一致性。
motivation: 自回归视频扩散可作为自动驾驶仿真中 3DGS 的渲染时修复器，但部署要求低延迟下的高画质与强时序一致性。这对单步因果生成尤为困难：每次不完美的预测会立刻成为后续帧的上下文，而现有方法依赖分阶段训练、多模块与 rollout 感知正则，单步质量仍达不到部署要求。
method: OneFixer 在单一任务特定适配阶段训练一个单步自回归视频扩散修复器，核心是“与部署匹配的共享 rollout”：模型自身的一步预测直接作为 flow matching 的因果上下文，使训练暴露于部署时的误差，同时该 rollout 直接接受像素空间感知监督以保留细节，从而联合学习保真度与自回归鲁棒性，无需双向到因果的转换或教师-学生蒸馏；此外还利用驾驶仿真易得的车道几何与动态智能体状态线索提升几何保真度。
result: 在 Waymo 与私有驾驶场景的 900 帧 rollout 上，OneFixer 在单步设置下取得最低的 FVD、LPIPS 与 DISTS，时序一致性匹配或超过多阶段 DMD 流水线；在相同骨干与条件化下，以不到一半的 GPU 小时数达到多阶段 DMD-with-Self-Forcing 的水平并持续提升；在结合驾驶策略的闭环仿真中，相较原始 3DGS 渲染将碰撞率降低三分之一。
conclusion: 该工作表明单步自回归修复器可在单阶段训练中同时获得高保真度与自回归鲁棒性，显著降低训练成本，并提升下游闭环驾驶仿真的安全性，为 3DGS 驾驶场景的低延迟渲染修复提供了实用方案。

title: GraphWrit3R: End-to-End 3D Scene Graph Writing
abstract: 3D scene graphs provide a structured representation of complex environments by encoding objects, their semantic attributes, and the spatial and functional relationships between them. Current approaches for 3D scene graph generation suffer from several fundamental limitations. They rely on complex multi-stage pipelines with explicit intermediate representations, making systems fragile and prone to error propagation. They assume access to ground-truth object annotations during inference, which deviates from real-world scenarios. They depend on proprietary models, hindering open-source deployment, or incur prohibitively slow inference. We present GraphWrit3R, a simple end-to-end method that takes a 3D point cloud, Gaussian Splats, or a combination of both as input, and directly outputs a complete scene graph as a structured JSON script. The graph lists all objects, their semantic attributes, and the relationships between them, while avoiding all of the above mentioned limitations. The choice of multiple input modalities is purely for versatility, allowing a single set of weights to handle diverse scenarios. Point cloud inputs are encoded via Sonata and Gaussian Splat inputs via Chorus, with both modalities projected onto a shared voxel grid and fused through a novel per-voxel contrastive alignment loss before being decoded by a large language model. As a natural consequence of the LLM, GraphWrit3R also supports open-vocabulary querying. On the 3DSSG benchmark, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on object class, predicate, and triplet recall, outperforming methods that rely on ground-truth object annotations during inference. We further provide qualitative results and analyze different input modality configurations, contrastive loss formulations, and token fusion strategies.
tldr: GraphWrit3R以端到端方式将点云或高斯泼溅直接写成完整3D场景图JSON，并在3DSSG上取得SOTA。
motivation: 现有3D场景图生成方法依赖复杂多阶段流水线与显式中间表示，易导致误差传播，且推理时假设可获得真值物体标注，不符合真实场景；部分方法还依赖闭源模型或推理过慢，阻碍开源部署。
method: 提出端到端方法GraphWrit3R，输入3D点云、高斯泼溅或二者组合，点云经Sonata编码、高斯泼溅经Chorus编码，二者投影到共享体素网格，并通过新颖的逐体素对比对齐损失融合，最终由大语言模型解码为结构化JSON场景图；得益于LLM，还支持开放词汇查询。
result: 在3DSSG基准上，GraphWrit3R在物体类别、谓词和三元组召回率上均达到SOTA，超过推理时依赖真值物体标注的方法；论文还提供定性结果，并分析不同输入模态配置、对比损失形式与token融合策略。
conclusion: GraphWrit3R以简单端到端框架直接生成完整3D场景图，避免多阶段误差传播、真值标注依赖与闭源限制，单组权重可处理多模态输入并支持开放词汇查询，有望推动可部署的3D场景理解与结构化表示研究。

title: OC-GS: Gaussian Splatting for Irregular Turntable Capture
abstract: Uneven rotation and dropped frames make equal-angle assumptions unreliable for turntable reconstruction. We present OC-GS, an object-centric Gaussian splatting that refines each image's angle while maintaining a shared camera, rotation axis, and pivot. This orbit-consistent refinement jointly optimizes image-derived geometry and angles to reconstruct objects from sparse, irregular captures. On rendered objects with 12, 8, and 6 irregularly spaced views, OC-GS achieves mean foreground PSNR scores of 21.26, 19.36, and 15.83dB, respectively, exceeding all four evaluated pose-free Gaussian splatting baselines in each condition. Under a shared trainer, refining image-estimated angles improves mean foreground PSNR by 7.88dB over keeping those estimates fixed. An ablation study shows that both image-derived angle initialization and the shared motion model contribute to the improvement. On real captures, OC-GS's refinement increases mean foreground PSNR by 0.70dB. Results show that refining uncertain angles within a shared motion model improves reconstruction from sparse, irregular turntable captures.
tldr: OC-GS在共享运动模型下联合精修图像角度与几何，提升稀疏不规则转台拍摄的物体重建质量。
motivation: 转台重建通常假设等角度拍摄，但不均匀旋转和丢帧使该假设不可靠，导致稀疏、不规则视角下的物体重建困难。
method: 提出以物体为中心的OC-GS，在共享相机、旋转轴与枢轴约束下，对每张图像的角度进行轨道一致性精修，并联合优化图像导出几何与角度。
result: 在12、8、6个不规则视角的渲染物体上，前景PSNR均值分别达21.26、19.36、15.83dB，均超过四个无位姿高斯泼溅基线；同一训练器下角度精修比固定估计提升7.88dB，真实拍摄提升0.70dB。
conclusion: 消融表明图像导出角度初始化与共享运动模型均有贡献；在共享运动模型内精修不确定角度可有效改善稀疏、不规则转台拍摄的物体重建。

title: ClearGS: Reliability-Aware Gaussian Splatting from Handheld Videos
abstract: We present ClearGS for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) from handheld videos with uneven viewpoint coverage and mixed frame quality. Rather than selecting frames with binary decisions, ClearGS uses Reliability-aware View Allocation (RVA) to assign graded raw-supervision weights based on appearance reliability, degradation risk, and geometric utility, while weakly reactivating useful suppressed frames to maintain trajectory coverage. Since weighting cannot restore details lost to blur or distortion, ClearGS further introduces Render-Guided In-Video Restoration (RIVR). The current 3DGS render provides a pose-aligned structural candidate, a frozen no-reference restoration expert restores the corresponding raw video observation without any clean reference image, and no-reference perceptual scores select among the render, restored observation, and high-frequency fused candidate. ClearGS then applies Full-Trajectory Repair Consolidation to revisit accepted repairs and preserve details introduced early. On GS2E and GSOTM, ClearGS achieves state-of-the-art overall performance, with consistent CLIP-IQA and MUSIQ gains and LPIPS reductions in most degradation settings, without paired sharp supervision or matched clean references.
tldr: ClearGS通过可靠性感知视图分配与渲染引导视频内修复，从手持视频重建高质量3D高斯泼溅。
motivation: 手持视频常存在视角覆盖不均与帧质量混杂问题，现有方法多采用二值选帧，难以在无配对清晰监督下兼顾轨迹覆盖与细节恢复。研究旨在从退化手持视频中鲁棒地重建高质量3D高斯泼溅。
method: 提出Reliability-aware View Allocation（RVA），按外观可靠性、退化风险和几何效用分配分级原始监督权重，并弱激活有用被抑制帧以维持轨迹覆盖；进一步引入Render-Guided In-Video Restoration（RIVR），以当前3DGS渲染为姿态对齐结构候选，借助冻结无参考修复专家恢复原始观测，并用无参考感知分数在渲染、修复观测和高频融合候选间选择；最后通过Full-Trajectory Repair Consolidation回访已接受修复以保留早期细节。
result: 在GS2E与GSOTM数据集上取得SOTA整体性能，在大多数退化设置中CLIP-IQA和MUSIQ一致提升、LPIPS降低，且无需配对清晰监督或匹配干净参考图像。
conclusion: ClearGS证明可靠性分级监督与渲染引导无参考修复可有效提升手持视频3DGS重建质量，为退化视频下的鲁棒三维重建提供了新思路，并有望推动手持采集与无参考修复结合的实际应用。

title: Vision-Based 6-DoF Grasp Pose Estimation for Robot Cloth Unfolding
abstract: Cloth manipulation is a challenging task due to the deformable and high-dimensional nature of cloth, which leads to complex interaction dynamics and perceptual ambiguity arising from frequent occlusions of critical visual cues such as folds, edges, and grasp points. In this work, we tackle cloth unfolding using a regrasping-in-the-air strategy, where one manipulator holds the cloth while the other grasps it at an optimally selected point to unfold it. To this end, we propose CeDiRNet-6DoF, a deep learning framework that jointly predicts effective grasp points and the complete 6-DoF grasp pose from the observed cloth configuration. By integrating dense 3D grasp regression with segmentation and sine-cosine-encoded Euler angles, the proposed method reliably estimates the grasp configuration that maximizes the unfolded cloth area. We extensively evaluated CeDiRNet-6DoF on a bimanual robotic setup within the ICRA 2024 Cloth Competition framework, achieving state-of-the-art performance. An ablation study further validates the benefits of key design components, including joint segmentation, background randomization, and image cropping. These results establish CeDiRNet-6DoF as a robust and versatile foundation for reliable robotic cloth manipulation in unstructured environments.
tldr: 提出CeDiRNet-6DoF，从视觉预测抓取点与6-DoF抓取位姿，实现机器人布料展开并达到SOTA。
motivation: 布料具有可变形、高维和复杂交互动力学，且折叠、边缘与抓取点常被遮挡，导致感知模糊。本文旨在通过单手固定布料、另一手空中重抓取策略，选择最优抓取点以最大化布料展开面积。
method: 提出CeDiRNet-6DoF深度学习框架，联合预测有效抓取点与完整6-DoF抓取位姿。方法融合密集3D抓取回归、分割以及正余弦编码欧拉角，可靠估计使布料展开面积最大化的抓取构型。
result: 在ICRA 2024 Cloth Competition框架下的双机械臂平台上广泛评估，取得最先进性能。消融实验进一步验证了联合分割、背景随机化和图像裁剪等关键设计组件的收益。
conclusion: 结果表明CeDiRNet-6DoF可作为非结构化环境中可靠且通用的机器人布料操作基础，为视觉6-DoF抓取与布料展开任务提供了有效方案。

title: RECAST: From Log Replay to Closed-Loop Driving Simulation with View-Complete Actors
abstract: Closed-loop driving simulation requires rendered observations to remain reliable as the ego vehicle and surrounding actors move beyond their recorded trajectories, exposing views absent from the source log. Existing data-driven simulators reconstruct dynamic actors from sparse observations, which can result in rendering artifacts under these viewpoint changes. We introduce RECAST (REconstructing Controllable Actors for Simulation and Testing), a 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that generates a view-complete actor from a single segmented vehicle observation in a driving log and registers the generated actor in the reconstructed scene. RECAST supports planner-in-the-loop rendering under controlled ego-actor interactions. To adapt an image-to-3D prior to real vehicles, we further introduce RECAR, a dataset of approximately 20K real vehicles with 600K background-free RGBA images spanning diverse vehicle colors and types. We use two-stage adaptation to improve vehicle generation from real driving-log observations. At the actor level, RECAST reduces $\mathrm{FD}_{\mathrm{incep}}$ from 9.788 to 7.992 relative to unadapted TRELLIS. At the scene level, under actor motion beyond logged trajectories, RECAST reduces $\mathrm{FD}_{\mathrm{incep}}$ from 129.35 to 112.10 and increases $\mathrm{CLIP}_{\mathrm{margin}}$ ($\times1000$) from 0.14 to 3.47 relative to Street Gaussians. We demonstrate planner-in-the-loop simulation with the image-conditioned planner GTRS-Dense. Compared with native Street Gaussians actors, RECAST increases the no-collision (NC) rate from 22.2% (12/54) to 63.0% (34/54) and the mean minimum predicted time-to-collision (TTC) from 0.798 s to 2.150 s. These experiments show that RECAST supports closed-loop planner evaluation under controlled ego-actor interactions beyond log replay. Visit our project page at https://zijunkr.github.io/RECAST/
tldr: RECAST 从单目车辆观测生成视角完备的交通参与者，实现超越日志回放的闭环驾驶仿真。
motivation: 闭环驾驶仿真要求自车与周围交通参与者驶出日志轨迹时，渲染观测仍保持可靠，但现有数据驱动模拟器仅从稀疏观测重建动态交通参与者，导致视角变化下出现渲染伪影。为此，需要生成视角完备且可控制的交通参与者。
method: 提出 RECAST，一种基于 3D Gaussian Splatting 的框架，可从驾驶日志中单个分割车辆观测生成视角完备的交通参与者，并将其配准到重建场景中，支持受控自车-参与者交互下的规划器在环渲染。为将图像到 3D 先验适配到真实车辆，构建 RECAR 数据集（约 2 万真实车辆、60 万张无背景 RGBA 图像，涵盖多种颜色与车型），并采用两阶段适配提升真实驾驶日志观测的车辆生成效果。
result: 在交通参与者层面，RECAST 相比未适配 TRELLIS 将 FD_incep 从 9.788 降至 7.992；在场景层面，当交通参与者运动超出日志轨迹时，相比 Street Gaussians 将 FD_incep 从 129.35 降至 112.10，并将 CLIP_margin（×1000）从 0.14 提升至 3.47。与图像条件规划器 GTRS-Dense 进行规划器在环仿真时，相比原始 Street Gaussians 交通参与者，RECAST 将无碰撞率从 22.2%（12/54）提升至 63.0%（34/54），平均最小预测碰撞时间 TTC 从 0.798 秒提升至 2.150 秒。
conclusion: 实验表明，RECAST 能在受控自车-交通参与者交互下支持超越日志回放的闭环规划器评估。其贡献包括视角完备交通参与者生成、RECAR 数据集与两阶段适配方法，有望提升闭环驾驶仿真的可靠性与规划器评测有效性。

title: ChronoFuseGS: Multi-Temporal Gaussian Fusion with Per-Splat Persistence and Change Visualization
abstract: Reconstructing environments where parts of the scene change between captured image sets poses a challenge for 3D scene reconstruction. We present ChronoFuseGS, a multi-temporal Gaussian Splatting approach that addresses this issue by taking multiple separately trained Gaussian Splatting models, each representing a distinct timestep and partially overlapping in geographic coverage, and merging them into a single combined model. By allowing Gaussians from one timestep to contribute to the reconstruction at other timesteps, our approach leverages data across all captured timesteps to refine persistent parts of the scene. The model supports incremental extension, allowing new timesteps to be added while preserving the existing merged reconstruction. It encodes, for each Gaussian primitive, at which timesteps it contributes to the reconstruction. To support visual exploration of the reconstructed scene, we present a change-aware visualization approach that highlights the parts of the scene that have changed across a user-defined time selection, while preserving the color of persistent parts. Since the persistence encoding operates at the Gaussian primitive level, changes are visualized at sub-object granularity rather than being limited to object-level changes. We evaluate our approach on a real-world outdoor dataset of a flood management area, captured over 7 months across eight recording days and covering seasonal vegetation changes, snow cover, and flooding events, which we make publicly available. Our results demonstrate that the combined model consistently outperforms individually trained single-timestep models in novel-view synthesis quality, recovers structural details absent in the individual reconstructions, and reliably highlights changes in fine details and sub-parts of objects and natural structures.
tldr: ChronoFuseGS 将多个独立训练的高斯泼溅模型融合为统一多时相模型，提升新视角合成并支持子物体级变化可视化。
motivation: 重建在不同时间拍摄的图像集之间发生部分变化的环境是3D重建的难点；现有单时相高斯模型无法跨时相共享信息，也难以在保持持久结构的同时突出局部变化。
method: ChronoFuseGS 将多个分别训练且地理覆盖部分重叠的单时相 Gaussian Splatting 模型合并为统一模型，允许某一时相的高斯在其他时相参与重建以利用全部时相数据精化持久部分，并为每个高斯基元编码其贡献时相，从而支持增量加入新时相；可视化方面提出变化感知渲染，在用户选定的时间范围内高亮变化区域并保留持久区域颜色。
result: 在公开的洪泛管理区户外数据集（7个月、8个记录日，含季节植被变化、积雪和洪水事件）上，融合模型在新视角合成质量上持续优于单独训练的单时相模型，恢复了个体重建缺失的结构细节，并能可靠高亮物体和自然结构的细粒度变化。
conclusion: 该方法证明跨时相高斯融合可提升多时相重建质量，并实现子物体级变化可视化，支持增量式时相扩展，对长期环境监测和变化分析具有应用潜力；同时公开了该户外数据集。

title: Gauss What You Need: Compact Gaussian Splatting Across Scene Scales
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructs a scene as a collection of Gaussian primitives from a set of posed photographs called the capture. The number of primitives used to represent the scene affects reconstruction quality, storage, and rendering cost. How to select this number automatically across capture scales remains unresolved: configurations effective on standard benchmarks can leave larger captures with too few Gaussians to reconstruct fine details. We observe that the surface to represent, given by the capture's extent and resolution, is known before training, whereas its content complexity becomes apparent during training, through the reconstruction quality on the training views. We introduce TangoGS, which combines capture-derived model sizing with training-based adaptation: the capture determines the scale of the model, and training feedback determines its final size within that scale. Before training, TangoGS derives a learning allowance for model growth from the capture's total pixels after discounting views that re-observe the same scene points. During training, reconstruction quality guides how many Gaussians to add and remove. On 13 standard benchmark scenes, TangoGS matches the mean PSNR of the best-performing evaluated baseline, LeGS, with $48\%$ fewer Gaussians. On eight large captures, the same configuration automatically scales to larger models when necessary, achieving the highest mean PSNR among evaluated methods: $0.54$ dB above the runner-up with $2.3\times$ as many Gaussians. Together, capture-derived learning allowances and training-quality guided density control enable a state-of-the-art quality--size compromise across scene scales without retuning.
tldr: TangoGS利用捕获像素预算与训练质量反馈自适应控制高斯数量，在跨场景尺度上实现更优质量-尺寸权衡。
motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting用高斯原语表示场景，其数量直接影响重建质量、存储与渲染开销；但如何在不同捕获尺度下自动选择高斯数量仍未解决。标准基准上有效的配置，在更大捕获中可能因高斯过少而无法重建细节。
method: TangoGS结合捕获推导的模型规模与训练自适应：训练前根据捕获总像素并扣除重复观测同一场景点的视角，推导模型增长的学习预算；训练中依据训练视图重建质量引导高斯原语的添加与删除。
result: 在13个标准基准场景上，TangoGS以少48%的高斯数量达到与最佳评估基线LeGS相同的平均PSNR；在8个大捕获上，同一配置自动按需扩展模型，取得评估方法中最高的平均PSNR，比第二名高0.54 dB，高斯数量为后者的2.3倍。
conclusion: 捕获推导的学习预算与训练质量引导的密度控制相结合，使TangoGS无需重新调参即可在跨场景尺度上实现当前最优的质量-尺寸折中。

title: PICO: Projection-Informed Consistency Optimisation for 6DoF Surgical Tool Pose Estimation
abstract: Purpose: Accurate 6 DoF pose estimation of surgical tools is critical for automa- tion, robotic proprioception, and safe interaction with the tissue operated on. Kinematics-based approaches suffer from accumulated errors due to the cable- driven nature of robotic arms, while vision-based methods often rely on external markers or trackers. Although more recent vision-based advances have been pro- posed, these two-stage pose estimation methods often lack real-time robustness due to accumulated errors and computational overhead. Methods: We propose a novel end-to-end trainable model, PICO. Our model employs a multi-task learning architecture to predict segmentation and depth maps, alongside regression of translation and rotation parameters. We define two proxy tasks that enforce geometric consistency in both 2D and 3D spaces, improving accuracy and robustness. For this, we propose a projection loss, and a point-to-point loss. Results: We evaluate our method on the SurgRIPE dataset, benchmarking its performance against state-of-the-art approaches using standard 6DoF pose esti- mation metrics. Our results demonstrate consistently strong performance across all four subsets, specifically in rotation, ranking second even under occlusion. It also demonstrates comparable translational performance, remaining competitive, especially in occluded cases. Conclusion: PICO demonstrates the effectiveness of multi-task learning and geometry-aware proxy tasks for robust and reliable surgical tool pose estimation, especially in occluded scenarios, highlighting potential for future applications.
tldr: PICO通过多任务学习与投影一致性损失实现端到端6DoF手术器械位姿估计，在遮挡下表现鲁棒。
motivation: 手术器械6DoF位姿估计对自动化、机器人本体感知和安全组织交互至关重要，但基于运动学的方法因机械臂线缆驱动而累积误差，基于视觉的方法常依赖外部标记或追踪器，且两阶段方法因累积误差和计算开销缺乏实时鲁棒性。
method: 提出端到端可训练模型PICO，采用多任务学习架构同时预测分割图、深度图并回归平移与旋转参数；引入投影损失和点对点损失两个代理任务，在2D和3D空间强制几何一致性以提升精度与鲁棒性。
result: 在SurgRIPE数据集上使用标准6DoF位姿估计指标与SOTA方法对比，在全部四个子集上表现稳定，旋转估计即使遮挡下也排名第二，平移性能相当，遮挡场景中仍具竞争力。
conclusion: PICO验证了多任务学习和几何感知代理任务在手术器械位姿估计中的有效性，尤其在遮挡场景下实现鲁棒可靠估计，具有未来应用潜力。

title: DAPEVO: Deep Adaptive Patch Frame-Event Visual Odometry
abstract: Visual odometry is essential for autonomous navigation in GPS-denied environments, yet RGB-based methods remain vulnerable to motion blur, challenging illumination, and dropped frames. Event cameras complement conventional cameras with high temporal resolution and dynamic range, but their asynchronous measurements complicate reliable correspondence estimation. We present DAPEVO, a learned visual odometry system that estimates image and event correspondences independently at shared patch locations and fuses their correlation evidence before motion refinement. Each tracked patch maintains image and event descriptors, and a learned scalar gate combines modality-specific correlation embeddings for each patch--frame edge before a shared recurrent refinement and bundle-adjustment update. DAPEVO also supports event-only observations, enabling continued tracking when RGB frames are sparse or unavailable, while modality-aware keyframe culling preserves scarce frame constraints. On UZH-FPV, when retaining only one in six RGB frames, DAPEVO's mean absolute trajectory error (ATE) increases by only 36%, from 1.00 to 1.36m, whereas the ATE of DPVO and RAMP-VO rises by factors of $3.7\times$ and $3.1\times$, respectively. On TartanEvent, DAPEVO similarly remains below 1m ATE at 3Hz RGB input, while DPVO and RAMP-VO exceed 9m. Under degraded RGB input on TartanEvent, DAPEVO achieves an ATE of 0.60m, compared with more than 4m for both DPVO and RAMP-VO, while also outperforming event-only DEVO at 0.87m.
tldr: DAPEVO在共享patch上独立估计图像与事件对应并门控融合，提升稀疏或退化RGB下的视觉里程计鲁棒性。
motivation: RGB视觉里程计在运动模糊、光照挑战和丢帧时易失效，而事件相机虽具高时间分辨率与动态范围，其异步测量却使可靠对应估计困难。论文旨在融合帧与事件互补信息，解决稀疏或退化RGB条件下的鲁棒里程计问题。
method: DAPEVO在每个共享patch位置分别估计图像和事件对应，并在运动细化前融合两类相关性证据。每个跟踪patch维护图像与事件描述子，学习到的标量门控按patch-帧边组合模态相关嵌入，再经共享循环细化与BA更新；同时支持纯事件观测和模态感知关键帧剔除。
result: 在UZH-FPV仅保留1/6 RGB帧时，DAPEVO平均ATE从1.00m仅增至1.36m（+36%），而DPVO和RAMP-VO分别增至3.7倍和3.1倍。TartanEvent 3Hz RGB下DAPEVO ATE低于1m，DPVO/RAMP-VO超过9m；退化RGB下DAPEVO ATE为0.60m，优于纯事件方法DEVO的0.87m，并远优于DPVO/RAMP-VO的4m以上。
conclusion: DAPEVO验证了自适应帧-事件patch融合与门控机制在稀疏/退化RGB及纯事件场景下的有效性，为GPS拒止环境自主导航提供了更鲁棒的里程计方案。

title: Spackle: Completing Large View Single Image NVS with Adaptive Gaussians
abstract: Single-image novel view synthesis (NVS) enables photorealistic rendering of un- observed viewpoints from a single input. Practical NVS systems require two key capabilities: robust reconstruction of occluded regions and high inference effi- ciency. While hybrid decoupled frameworks combining feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) and diffusion models show promise for large-view-deviation NVS, they suffer from capacity competition: a fixed number of Gaussians forces resource shifts from visible to newly disoccluded areas, degrading original scene fidelity when the target view deviates significantly from the input. To address this, we propose Spackle, a lightweight residual learning framework that mit- igates capacity competition without sacrificing efficiency. Spackle operates in three stages: predicting base 3DGS attributes from given views, automatically identifying poorly reconstructed regions, and learning a residual 3DGS optimized exclusively for these areas. At inference, we combine the baseline and aug- mented Gaussians for NVS. We conduct comprehensive experiments and show that Spackle achieves state-of-the-art performance on large-view-deviation cases.
tldr: Spackle通过残差3DGS补充重建不足区域，缓解容量竞争，在大视角单图NVS取得SOTA。
motivation: 单图新视角合成需在遮挡区域稳健重建并保持高推理效率；现有前馈3DGS与扩散模型混合框架在目标视角偏离输入较大时，固定数量高斯会从可见区域转向新消隐区域，造成容量竞争并降低原始场景保真度。
method: 提出Spackle轻量残差学习框架，分三步：从给定视角预测基础3DGS属性，自动识别重建较差区域，并仅针对这些区域学习残差3DGS；推理时合并基础高斯与增强高斯进行NVS。
result: 在综合实验中，Spackle在大视角偏差场景上取得SOTA表现；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: Spackle在不牺牲推理效率的前提下缓解容量竞争，提升大视角单图NVS对遮挡与新消隐区域的补全能力；其残差学习思路为实用化单图NVS提供了有效方案。

title: Reliability-Regulated Trajectory Optimization for Progressive COLMAP-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: COLMAP-free 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) bypasses computationally expensive structure-from-motion (SfM) pipelines, yet progressive camera pose tracking remains fundamentally vulnerable to error compounding---early pairwise tracking inaccuracies both corrupt subsequent frame initializations and remain permanently frozen in the scene representation. Rather than relying on heavyweight external neural priors or treating progressive tracking through isolated heuristic fixes, we propose a unified reliability-regulated trajectory optimization framework for progressive COLMAP-free 3DGS. At its core, our framework establishes an intrinsic, self-supervised bidirectional cycle-consistency mechanism that systematically regulates progressive camera trajectory estimation across two complementary temporal horizons: (1) Forward Motion Propagation, where the online reliability signal adaptively gates first-order kinematic warm-starts of rigid motion into upcoming pairwise registrations, supplying informed directional search priors while safely intercepting untrusted transitions; and (2) Retrospective Trajectory Correction, where the same reliability signal dynamically weights relative-pose consistency constraints within a sliding window of neighboring camera poses. By governing both prospective state initialization and retrospective trajectory consolidation through a unified reliability regulator, our self-contained framework resolves progressive drift without external priors or offline preprocessing. Extensive evaluations on Tanks and Temples and CO3D-V2 benchmarks show that our method substantially improves camera trajectory accuracy and novel-view rendering quality, outperforming existing unposed baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/Zijian1026/RRTO-CF3DGS.
tldr: 提出可靠性调控轨迹优化框架，无需COLMAP即可渐进式追踪相机位姿并提升3DGS重建质量。
motivation: COLMAP-free 3DGS虽绕过昂贵的SfM流程，但渐进式相机位姿追踪存在误差累积问题：早期成对追踪误差会污染后续帧初始化，并永久冻结在场景表示中。现有方法依赖重型外部神经先验或孤立启发式修复，本文旨在用统一框架解决渐进漂移。
method: 核心是自监督双向循环一致性机制，在两种时间跨度上调控轨迹估计：前向运动传播利用在线可靠性信号自适应门控一阶刚性运动热启动，为后续成对配准提供方向先验并拦截不可信过渡；回溯轨迹校正则用同一可靠性信号动态加权滑动窗口内相邻相机位姿的相对位姿一致性约束。该统一可靠性调节器同时管理前瞻状态初始化与回溯轨迹整合，无需外部先验或离线预处理。
result: 在Tanks and Temples和CO3D-V2基准上，方法显著提升相机轨迹精度和新视角渲染质量，优于现有无位姿（unposed）基线；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 提出统一的可靠性调控渐进式COLMAP-free 3DGS轨迹优化框架，以自监督双向循环一致性同时约束前瞻初始化与回溯校正，无需外部先验或离线预处理即可缓解渐进漂移，为无SfM场景重建与无位姿新视角合成提供了新思路。

title: From Mono to Stereo: Accelerating Binocular Gaussian Splatting via Reprojection and Selective Patching
abstract: Binocular rendering requires two nearby views of the same scene and therefore repeats substantial visibility and shading work. We present a 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) pipeline that fully renders a dominant-eye RGB image and an alpha-weighted depth proxy, reprojects that image to the affiliated eye, and repairs uncovered pixels. Small interior gaps are interpolated, whereas larger disoccluded regions are identified as regions of interest (ROIs) and selectively re-rendered. The depth proxy reuses the alpha-blending weights computed during dominant-eye rasterization, avoiding a separate depth-rendering pass. An adaptive ROI generator localizes the required updates using reprojected image boundaries and optional connected center-hole detection. On DTU, Tanks and Temples, and MipNeRF-360, the method reduces the measured time of a sequential two-pass binocular reference by 15.5\% to 28.8\% and peak GPU memory by 6\% to 11\%. The corresponding affiliated-eye quality degradation is at most 1.3 dB PSNR, 0.02 SSIM, and 0.02 LPIPS, representing a measurable trade-off that requires application-specific perceptual validation. These results establish a practical efficiency-quality trade-off for controlled static-scene stereo rendering and motivate future evaluation under continuous motion and on physical VR hardware.
tldr: 提出一种双目2DGS加速管线，通过主眼渲染、重投影和选择性修补高效生成副眼图像。
motivation: 双目渲染需为同一场景生成两个相邻视角，导致可见性与着色计算被大量重复，传统顺序两遍方法时间和显存开销高。本文旨在面向受控静态场景，在可接受质量损失下加速双目2D高斯泼溅渲染。
method: 基于2DGS，先完整渲染主眼的RGB图像与alpha加权深度代理，再将其重投影到副眼并修复未覆盖像素；小内部间隙通过插值填补，大去遮挡区域被识别为ROI并选择性重渲染。深度代理复用主眼光栅化得到的alpha混合权重，避免单独深度渲染，自适应ROI生成器利用重投影图像边界和可选连通中心孔检测定位更新区域。
result: 在DTU、Tanks and Temples和MipNeRF-360上，相比顺序两遍双目参考，测量时间降低15.5%至28.8%，峰值GPU内存降低6%至11%。副眼质量最多下降1.3 dB PSNR、0.02 SSIM和0.02 LPIPS。
conclusion: 该方法为受控静态场景立体渲染建立了实用的效率-质量权衡，但质量下降仍需按应用进行感知验证，并推动未来在连续运动和真实VR硬件上评估。

title: Towards Practical Compression of 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality novel-view synthesis but requires substantial storage. Existing compression methods often rely on spatial context modeling over irregular 3D representations, increasing the complexity of training and coding.
